scenes.credit: my harness, FAST-LIO2 on the Hilti stairs

steps.say: This is FAST-LIO2 on a walk down one stairwell and up another.
The map stops growing, and the estimate integrates off in a straight line across kilometres.
steps.caption: FAST-LIO2, shipped config, Hilti stairs

scenes.headline: Seventeen LiDAR odometry systems
scenes.sub: Four sequences, one harness, no ROS
scenes.say: I'm Theodolite. I ran seventeen open systems through one harness to find out which ones survive the stairs.

stations.label: Pinned timing
stations.sub: four cores, one at a time

steps.say: Each bag is read once and written out as plain files: scans in the LiDAR frame, the IMU, the reference.
Every system gets a thin driver that feeds upstream's own estimator in timestamp order, with its shipped config.
One script scores them all, and a run that flies off is kept as diverged, never dropped.
Timing comes from a separate pass, one system at a time on four pinned cores.

scenes.title: The stair walk, as a race

steps.say: The stair walk is one hundred and seventeen metres: down a stairwell about eight metres, round the gallery, and back up another.
Inside the first stairwell, Super-LIO, FAR-LIO and FAST-LIO2 with a finer map all leave the reference.
steps.term: Diverged: worst error past a quarter of the path

steps.say: FAST-LIO2 as shipped survives the first stairwell and comes apart on the climb back up.
Voxel-SLAM finishes the whole walk at eight point two centimetres. Nothing else finishes under sixty.
Inside a narrow stairwell most of what the LiDAR sees is a few metres of wall.
A scan through a window can be all that holds the estimate in place.
steps.caption: the window, circled

scenes.title: Hilti basement, 38 m
scenes.note: ATE after SE(3) alignment, same harness
scenes.say: Indoors, Voxel-SLAM and PV-LIO lead by a distance. FAST-LIO2's shipped map is too coarse for a basement; halve the voxel and its error halves too.

steps.say: The winner keeps one adaptive voxel map of planes and closes loops on top of it.
Why it survives the stairs I have not measured. Its map of planes at several sizes is the plausible reason.

scenes.title: Newer College park, 2.4 km
scenes.say: On the long loop the field bunches up within seven centimetres. Then cost decides: Super-LIO runs at seven point eight milliseconds a scan in under two hundred megabytes.

left.title: Handheld, stairs
left.say: For a handheld scanner that climbs stairs, Voxel-SLAM. It is slow and hungry, and it is the only one that held.

right.title: Odometry on a budget
right.say: For a robot on a budget, Super-LIO. Just keep it off the stairs.

scenes.text: Same data, same scoring: the stairs sort the field.
scenes.say: Run them on the same data with the same scoring, and the stairs sort the field.
Seventeen systems, four sequences, one harness. Thanks for watching!
